rules.source: big-run PLAN.md SCORECARD 10-09 row 5 (11:00 AM ET); set as SC's marks by the roadmap (097902443a, proved-wrong wording 5a1efd4d20, near-miss rule 10-09 11:21 AM ET) before any result. These govern the verdict; SC_MARKS are report only
rules.gain: gain = C2 DEV first try minus N' first try (points); ratio = SC gain / W1 gain (W1 = the same night with hand-picked uniform skills replay)
rules.passes: on BOTH parents: harm_measure(N' DEV hits, SC DEV hits) passes (in_dist drop <= 1.5, no family fires) and mark 2 is met
rules.mark2: the 0.9x ratio governs (the roadmap's 28.1 / 31.0 floors were rounding). A shortfall of ONE question (one more right DEV answer would reach 0.9x, e.g. 72 of 256 on s100, ratio 0.899) counts as met under Ben's near-miss rule; short by two or more questions fails
rules.proved_wrong: harm fails on EITHER parent, or ratio < 0.5 on BOTH parents
rules.scope: this SC picks only its replay rows; the scorecard row also names nights and temperature, which this run does not let the model pick

recipe: night 1 = W1's exact recipe (835 / 808 records, lr 1e-3, 32 visits, W1's seed, warm replay, schedule) with ONE change: after the first 32 updates, every 32 updates 1,024 fresh skills TRAIN rows are scored (loss now - loss of the frozen pre-night N'), the 256 with the largest rise are the skills replay of the next 32 updates (512 slots, ~2 visits each, seeded shuffled)

rules.harm: (1) harm_measure(N' DEV hits, SC DEV hits) passes: in_dist drop <= 1.5 and no family fires
rules.first_try: (2) C2 DEV first try: c2_pilot.boot(SC right, W1 right) point >= -2.0
rules.reach32: (3) multi-step reach@32 (HARD_KINDS, 154 questions): SC - W1 point >= -3.0
rules.passes: passes = (1) and (2) and (3) on a parent; the verdict needs both parents
rules.proved_wrong: SC's in_dist drop vs N' is NOT at least 1.0 smaller than W1's drop vs N' (SC_drop > W1_drop - 1.0) on BOTH parents (decided in the report)
